title: mariscus lucidus
intro: Mariscus lucidus, commonly known as Sphagneticola trilobata, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Mariscus lucidus include its ability to calm the nervous system, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and insomnia, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the prevention of infections. The bioactive constituents of Mariscus lucidus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
